strict_gate_faithful_remeasurement.methodology: calls production minimize::minimize_with_policy(Mmff94BondAngleStrict) directly, same as PR #226/issue #227's original methodology
strict_gate_faithful_remeasurement.note: historical issue #227 reported 38 success / 216 missing_parameters / 11 typed_failure on an earlier main; today's main (382a5f3) has moved since (PR #226/#229/#231 etc merged) -- this is a fresh remeasurement, not a reused historical number

term_level_coverage_simplified_gate.note: independent bond+angle Some/None recheck (not calling minimize_with_policy) -- 221/265 would-fail, consistent with the faithful remeasurement above

dominant_single_mismatch.meaning: chematic assigns 6-ring aromatic carbon (e.g. benzene) numeric type 63; real Halgren/RDKit numbering is 37. chematic's own comment for 63 claims '5-ring alpha' -- internally inconsistent with assigning it to benzene's 6-ring carbons.

naive_fix_simulation_negative_result.description: context-blind 3-constant swap (63<->37, 38->64), carbon only, no ring-context awareness
naive_fix_simulation_negative_result.conclusion: does NOT meet the >=80% same-session-fix bar, and demonstrates real regression risk -- the real fix needs coordinated C+N+O+S ring-context-aware re-derivation, not a blind swap

furan_semantically_wrong_but_present_evi.example_bond: bond 0-1 (C-C, both chematic type 38) resolves via bond_type=0 to Some(BondEnergyParams { kb: 5.002, r0: 1.246 }) -- r0=1.246 A is a carbonyl/N-involved bond length in the real table (type 38 = pyridine-type N in the real numbering), not a plausible furan aromatic C-C bond length (~1.36-1.44 A) -- furan 'passes' the coverage gate today by silently hitting a semantically wrong-but-present row

decision: AUDIT-ONLY. Root cause (atom typing wrong for aromatic C/N/O/S numeric MMFF94 types) is singular and explains 98.5% of all missing terms by volume, but does NOT meet the Phase 1B same-session-fix bar: naive single-element correction only resolves 7.7% of molecule-level gate failures and causes 1 regression, proving the real fix requires comprehensive C+N+O+S re-derivation with its own RDKit energy-parity correctness gate -- out of scope for this session.
